## Standing operator rules
Run “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” between other work: replace Travis with GitHub Actions, validate, publish, then disable Travis. In order: (1) `git status --short && test -f .travis.yml && echo 'working tree checked; .travis.yml found'`; (2) `git switch -c gha/test-workflow`; (3) `ruby -ryaml -e 'p YAML.load_file(".travis.yml").slice("language","node_js","script","cache")'`; (4) `mkdir -p .github/workflows && echo '.github/workflows ready'`; (5) create workflow; (6) `actionlint .github/workflows/test.yml && echo 'workflow syntax valid'`; (7) commit; (8) push; (9) `travis disable && echo 'Travis CI disabled for this repository'`. Never request review on a branch changing `ledgerly/storage/queries.py` until `EXAMPLES.md` contains fresh EXPLAIN ANALYZE output for every modified query. Before changing retention behavior in `ledgerly/services/retention.py`, attach the expected deletion count to the ledgerly-privacy-impact ticket and request sign-off from the designated privacy approver. The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
SQLAlchemy upgrade is on hold. Add CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to 6 hours: stuck jobs become invisible for hours.

## Recent work
GitHub Actions steps 1–5 are complete; lint, commit, push, and Travis disabling remain. Test fixture refactoring reduced runtime from 42.18s to 16.63s; 318 passed and 4 skipped.
